NO DEFECTS FOUND.

- All identifiers used are defined (`FLOW`, `ORDER`, `ERR/P99/ERR_T/P99_T`, all derive helpers, all render functions). All `FLOW.steps.*` fields referenced (`ev`, `checks`, `runLabel`, `lines`, `doneText`, `lockedHint`, `confirmLabel`, `undoLabel`, `armedText`) exist on the respective step definitions. No duplicate ids in any branch (`btime` and `d2win` are distinct and each emitted once).

## Section 3 — State-machine logic breaks

1. **app.js:509-517 (with app.js:353) — CRITICAL dead-end: step `c1` is never added to `S.done`, so stage C can never complete and stage D never unlocks.** `S.done.add` sites are only: `c2` (353), `d2` (393), `b2` (534), `b1` (542), `d1` (559), and the generic `toggle-check` (502) — but only check-kind steps (a1/a2/a3/d3) emit `data-action="toggle-check"`; `c1` (kind `gate`) uses `toggle-c1`, which only mutates `S.c1` flags and logs, never `S.done`. Therefore `stageComplete('C')` = `['c1','c2'].every(stepDone)` (app.js:92) is permanently false → `stageActive('D')` false (app.js:93) → d1/d2/d3 render as "🔒 完成上一阶段后解锁" with no body (app.js:291) → the finishbar (app.js:321, requires D complete) never renders → **both scenario (a) and scenario (b) dead-end right after C2**: progress caps at 9/10 steps / 2 stages, certificate unreachable. Severity: dead-end. Fix: in the `toggle-c1` case (after app.js:513) add `if(now) S.done.add('c1'); else S.done.delete('c1');` (or add `S.done.add('c1');` alongside `S.done.add('c2')` in the rollout `onDone` at app.js:353).

2. **app.js:586-596 + app.js:448 — low-severity edge: reset while an irreversible modal is mid-execution leaves the modal permanently stuck.** The `#modal` overlay does not make the header chips inert (no focus trap/inert), so a keyboard-activated second press of `resetBtn` during the 3s arm window reassigns `S`; `modalConfirm`'s interval then hits the `S.seq !== seq0` guard (448), clears itself, but `M` stays non-null with `M.exec = true` — all modal controls render disabled and nothing can ever close it. Not reachable by mouse clicks (overlay blocks pointer), keyboard-only. Severity: dead-end (edge). Fix: guard the reset case with `if(M) return;` (or run `M = null; renderModal();` inside reset).

Verified clean: counts for scenario (b) are correct in the code as written — each modal run increments its counter exactly once (`rollout` only at app.js:353, `rollback` only at app.js:376, and rollback deliberately never calls `mistake`), and both c2 (rollout) and d2 (seal) are only reachable through their confirmation modals (`open-c2`/`seal` cases gate on `openModal`, with `mistake`+`shake` on premature attempts) — blocked only by finding 1. Reset mid-flow is otherwise sound: the `seq` guard invalidates in-flight `runWithLines`/`modalConfirm` intervals, and fresh state re-renders everything.

## Section 4 — index.html

NO DEFECTS FOUND. `styles.css` and `app.js` both exist beside index.html (confirmed by directory listing); the favicon is an inline `data:` URI; no duplicate ids; all containers used by the renderers (`#chips`, `#pfill`, `#nav`, `#panel`, `#log`, `#modal`, `#completion`, `#toasts`) are present (index.html:19, 21, 26, 35, 39, 43-45).

## Section 5 — styles.css

Every class emitted by JS that affects visibility (`overlay/show`, `modal + sev variants`, `banner open/sealed`, `step locked/irrev`, `btn` variants, `cert-*`, `toast`, `mrow warn`, `rlines`, `finishbar`, log `li` kinds) has a rule.
